stem:
Simran studies four Class 7 topics in one week: how vinegar reacts with baking soda, how a green leaf makes food in light, how a metal pan heats on a stove, and how seasons change as Earth moves around the Sun.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: These topics belong to different fields of science but are connected ways of studying the same world.
Looking across materials, living things, heat, and Earth motion can show links between the topics.
Materials and living things are connected, but heat and Earth motion are isolated topics.
Topics from different chapters must be treated as isolated subjects.

teacher.key_rationale: Science fields and chapter topics are connected ways of studying one world. Splitting heat and Earth motion off, or treating every chapter as isolated, misses that link.
